CA-governor.statusNote: Top-two primary held June 2 — Xavier Becerra (D) and Steve Hilton (R) advanced to November. California has no U.S. Senate race in 2026.

candidates.name: Xavier Becerra
candidates.background: U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary 2021–2025; California Attorney General 2017–2021 (filed 122 lawsuits against the first Trump administration); 24 years in the U.S. House. Advanced from the June 2026 top-two primary.

cost.label: Campaign centers affordability; negotiated Medicare drug prices 38–79% below list (Wikipedia)

health.label: Led multi-state defense of the ACA; ran Medicare drug-price negotiations as HHS Secretary (Wikipedia)

immigration.label: Led 21-state coalition defending DACA; sued over border-wall emergency declaration (Wikipedia)

climate.label: Created CA environmental-justice bureau; repeatedly sued to block environmental rollbacks (Wikipedia)

repro.label: Directed HHS to expand abortion-related care access after Dobbs (Wikipedia)

candidates.name: Steve Hilton
candidates.background: Author and former Fox News host; former adviser to UK Prime Minister David Cameron; runs on a 'Cali-ffordability' platform. Advanced from the June 2026 top-two primary.

cost.label: 'Cali-ffordability': blames regulation/taxation for high costs; deregulation platform (KEYT)

housing.label: Backed initiative barring private CEQA lawsuits and capping developer impact fees (Wikipedia)

immigration.label: Would end taxpayer-funded healthcare for undocumented immigrants; no broader plan stated (KEYT)

climate.label: '$3 gas,' halve electric bills through energy deregulation (KEYT)

safety.label: Reverse prison closures, expand capacity, implement Prop 36 (KEYT)
